ad_intro:
Wellbeing Nutrition (wellbeingnutrition.com) is a Wellness brand running ~35 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.30-60L/mo and ads pointing to website traffic to subscription/checkout. Clean-label supplements in which HUL holds a majority stake.

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: slow site, doctor-explainer videos missing - The gap: doctor-explainer / result UGC. (2) Landing page: a slow site with no doctor-explainer proof. (3) Tracking: A slow site adds friction and dilutes attribution; retargeting appears generic..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Mid-market/SMB lead - high closability with a fast test budget.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Slow site, doctor-explainer videos missing. The gap: doctor-explainer / result UGC.
Copy leak: Current angle is product-led. Missing angle: doctor-trust + result story.
Landing page leak: A slow site with no doctor-explainer proof.
Tracking leak: A slow site adds friction and dilutes attribution; retargeting appears generic.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy doctor-explainer / result UGC
Shoot 15 fifteen-second doctor-explainer / result UGC and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Speed up the site + add doctor-explainer and result UGC. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
